title: Goose v2 Skin QA
eyebrow: Ready for your check · Models #18, one fused skin and a neck root that forks into three · built on claude/project-thread-09ugci, not pushed

unverified: Nobody has opened goose_v2.glb or goose_v2.fbx in a game engine; the only thing that has run is the export from Blender
The colour on the skin is a stand-in carried over from version 1: a hard, ragged black-to-pale line crosses the breast and a few stray black marks sit on it, which #20 (textures) replaces
The rig and clips are not on the new model yet; that work is #21 (the rig), so nobody has seen the model bend
The whole model is 294,828 triangles, so #19 (muscle and feathers) has only 5,172 triangles left, not the 15,000 the plan estimated, and will have to trim elsewhere

short.lead: The version 2 goose is built. The body, the three necks, both wing arms and both legs are now one closed skin. One neck root rises from the chest and forks into three at about 3.05 m. The build checks these on every run: 294,828 triangles against the 300,000 budget, 6.750 m tall, and a skin of exactly 1 piece. Version 1's files are unchanged.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what was checked and what it needs from you.
items: One closed skin with smoothed joins

The close-ups, taken from the same cameras as the version 1 review, show no seam lines at the neck base, the side necks, the wing roots or the hips. The model went from 1,071 closed pieces to 1,064, because the 8 separate body parts (body, three necks, two wing arms, two legs) became 1.

items.alt: Version 2 neck base: one root forking into three necks with no seam where it meets the body
items.caption: Version 2, neck base from the front.

items: The wing arms now reach into the body

The new one-piece check failed on the first build: the skin came out in 3 pieces, because version 1's wing arms stop 0.1 m short of the body. In version 2 each arm now starts inside the body, at (0.35, -0.5, 2.4). The feathers still hang from the same shoulder, elbow, wrist and tip, so the wing has not moved.

items.alt: Version 2 wing root flowing into the body
items.caption: Version 2, wing root.
